roleInfo.name: Player
roleInfo.description: Match the most popular rhyme — and especially the Prime Rhymer's!

Default.everyRoundYouLl:
Every round, you'll see a single word (e.g., 'duck'). Type a word that rhymes with it.

If your rhyme matches EXACTLY ONE other player's rhyme, you both get 3 points. If it matches more than one other player, all of you get 1 point. Unique rhymes get 0.

Each round, one player is the Prime Rhymer (red border). If your rhyme matches theirs, you get a bonus +2 points on top of everything else. Everyone takes a turn as Prime Rhymer.
